title: Christmas Pudding Flapjack
hookLine: British-inspired christmas pudding flapjack with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 180°C/fan 160°C/gas mark 4 and grease and line a 25cm x 20cm tin. Melt the butter, sugar, syrup and orange zest in a large saucepan over a medium heat. The aim is to dissolve all the ingredients so that they are smooth, but to not lose any volume through boiling so be careful not to overheat. Incorporate {m52788_1}, {m52788_2}, and {m52788_3} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.activeMeasureSummary: salted butter, dark soft brown sugar
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure salted butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the oats and stir well until evenly coated. Stir through the leftover Christmas pudding and tip into the prepared tin. Use a spoon to flatten the top and bake for 40 minutes until the edges start to brown. Whilst still warm in the tin, score into 12 squares. Allow to cool completely before cutting along the scores.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m52788_4}, {m52788_5}, and {m52788_6} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Keeps for 5 days in an air tight tin or freeze for up to 1 month. Plate into 12 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
